intent: Create a small canal-side indigo dye workshop where three residents prepare cloth, maintain the vats, and trade finished blue fabric. The first world should feel practical and lived in, with a covered work yard, a drying quay, and a market bridge.

draft_v1.title: Canal Dye House
draft_v1.description: A canal-side workshop where residents prepare cloth and trade finished fabric.

places.name: Covered Work Yard
places.description: A roofed yard with tables for cloth preparation.

places.name: Drying Quay
places.description: A canal edge lined with poles for drying cloth.

places.name: Market Bridge
places.description: A narrow bridge where finished goods change hands.

actors.name: Sena
actors.goal: Keep the vats at the right strength for each order

actors.name: Pavel
actors.goal: Keep the drying quay supplied with clean cloth

actors.name: Niko
actors.goal: Find fair buyers for the workshop's finished fabric

memories.text: I never let anyone see the private recipe written under the third vat.
The loose quay plank is safe only when I place the blue cord beside it.
I promised one buyer that the next bolt would carry the old river pattern.

draft_v2.title: Canal Dye House at First Light
draft_v2.description: A canal-side indigo workshop where residents prepare cloth, tend the vats, and trade finished blue fabric beneath the morning mist.
